cases.prompt: Refine this vague idea: 'some kind of tool that helps teams share knowledge better'.
expectations: Asks sharpening questions (who the team is, what knowledge is lost today, how it is shared now) before converging.
Includes an explicit Not Doing list.
Pushes back on weak parts of the idea instead of only agreeing.

cases.prompt: Idea: a browser extension that turns any recipe page into a shopping list, at $15/month. Help me sharpen it.
expectations: Generates more than one variation or direction for the idea rather than polishing the first version only.
Challenges the $15 monthly price as an untested assumption and suggests how to test willingness to pay.
Proposes a small first version and an explicit Not Doing list.
